value.rationale: The support \(\{0,\pm1,\pm3\}\) is the first canonical five-point cyclic support with two coprime odd frequencies and nontrivial interference. The exact answer exposes a genuine arithmetic phase transition between even moduli, odd multiples of \(3\), and the two remaining odd residue classes, with explicit extremizers and dual certificates. This gives a structural finite-sampling benchmark in the established Turán framework rather than a table of isolated computations.
